title: LessonCompletedPayload
description: The source learning action from which gamification decisions may be derived. Reward, streak, quest, and badge outcomes are represented by separate events.

completion_id.description: Immutable identifier assigned by the learning service to this completed attempt. It must be preserved on every resend and is the business action identity.

lesson_id.description: Stable identifier of the completed lesson.

lesson_version.description: Optional immutable version of the lesson definition that was completed.

timezone.description: Learner IANA timezone at completion, for example Asia/Kolkata. It is used with the envelope occurred_at value to determine the learner's local activity day.

assignment_id.description: Optional quest assignment context for a completion delivered through ingestion.

completion_kind.description: Classification of the completed learning activity.
